import pulp
prob = pulp.LpProblem('p', pulp.LpMaximize)
a = pulp.LpVariable('a', lowBound=0)
b = pulp.LpVariable('b', lowBound=0)
prob += 3 * a + 2 * b
prob += a + b <= 10
prob += a + b <= 1
prob.solve(pulp.PULP_CBC_CMD(msg=0))
text: A plant can make chairs and tables. If the plant makes tables, it must also make chairs. Maximize profit.

b = pulp.LpVariable('b', lowBound=0)
